theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' :=
  fun u i => ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength i) (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined i) u) $ InitStatesNodup i, by
    profile_tactic "rw1" in (rw [InitStatesUpdated i, UpdateStatesUpdated u]
    unfold updatedStates)
    profile_tactic "rwcomm" in (rw [updatedStatesComm]
    exact updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength u) $ updatedStatesDefMonotone $ UpdateStatesDefined' u)
    profile_tactic "rwzip" in (rw [List.unzip_zip $ UpdateStatesLength u, List.unzip_zip $ InitStatesLength i]
    exact fun _ a b => absurd (UpdateStatesDefined u _ a) $ InitStatesNotDefined i _ b ▸ Bool.false_ne_true)⟩
